correctness.rationale: The source's general degree-four generic-orbit theorem gives the key function-field degree. Pair-sign invariance then forces \(\mathbf C(S'_P)=\mathbf C(S)^{G_P}\). The complete intersection is defined by diagonal quadrics, and every projective pair-sign class has determinant \(+1\), so the residue two-form is fixed and the lifted action on the crepant K3 resolution is symplectic. Matsumoto's tame symplectic quotient theorem yields an RDP K3 quotient; its minimal resolution and the dodecic resolution are smooth birational K3 surfaces and hence isomorphic. The bundled finite verifier exhausts all 15 coordinate pairings and checks the sign-group invariances used in the proof.

value.rationale: The claim removes the source's smooth-Bremner restriction from a natural quotient interpretation and uniformly identifies all 15 associated dodecic resolutions for every magic octic model with concrete Klein-four symplectic quotients. This gives a structural description that can feed directly into fixed-point, lattice, and Hodge calculations and closes a natural gap left between the paper's general degree-four orbit theorem and its special quotient proposition.
